name: Distinctive Plastics
old_description: Distinctive Plastics, Inc. also known as DPI, specializes in full-service technical injection molding solutions for some of the most complex challenges in plastic manufacturing. Our company was founded in 1981 to provide high quality, expert molding services to our customers both on time and within budget, from the start of the project to delivery of the parts and beyond.
about:
Distinctive Plastics, Inc. (DPI) was founded in 1981 in Vista, California, to deliver high-quality injection molding services on time and within budget. The company operates from a single California facility and remains privately held.

DPI provides full-service technical injection molding, covering product development, tooling design and manufacturing (both in-house and outsourced), injection molding including two-shot, multi-component, insert molding, and in-mold decoration (IMD). The facility includes a Class 8 clean room for medical device molding, and offers ultrasonic welding, component assembly, and other value-added services. Engineering support includes product design, DFM analysis, and mold flow analysis.

The company serves medical device manufacturers, electronics producers, sports and leisure equipment makers, and life science firms. Medical and electronics assemblies are produced in the certified clean room environment, while IMD capabilities support decorative and functional parts for consumer and industrial applications.

DPI positions itself as a pioneer in in-mold decoration technology, which reduces production steps and cost. The firm emphasizes its ISO 13485 and ISO 9001 certifications, FDA registration, and UL listing as foundations for regulated medical and electronic work.
